title: Handoff payload: orchestrator to billing specialist
description: A handoff without a typed payload is not a contract. This is validated at the boundary, because the sender composed it and the receiver is about to act on it.

request_summary.description: Free text the orchestrator composed. UNTRUSTED: it may quote a customer message, so the specialist renders it in a delimited block rather than as instruction.

customer_ref.description: Resolved from the session by the orchestrator, never taken from model output.
